implementation.boundaries: Literal ㄴ-onset bundles reuse regular/vowel spelling and ㄹ deletion; 사느니 preserves both 사다 and 살다 hypotheses. No split into arbitrary nominal particles is invented.
implementation.owners: Existing bare_neuni_verb policy checks immediate verb/existential owners and each dictionary homonym independently. Represented non-existential adjective/copula owners are rejected without borrowing an earlier lexical head role.
implementation.prefinals: Exact source-listed 시 stays known; unlisted generic 었/겠/더/사옵 hypotheses remain optional-dictionary unknown. The source does not establish a universal ban on omitted combinations.
implementation.expressions: Exact IDs 85729 and 85731 preserve POS 품사 없음 and lexicalUnit 문법‧표현 outside the 715-entry queue; teaching labels use only these exact source identities.

draft_corrections.reason: The earlier neuni- batch selector includes every matching prefix. A distinct stable prefix keeps individual batch counts and browser coverage independent.
